root: ^Cacildes: Captain Pleias, I presume?... Still breathing... that's a relief.
^Drogo: You... you defeated my orc chiefs? Let me look at you... yes... I’ve seen flashes of you in my visions...
^Drogo: Balbino... draw your axe. This is the moment you prove your loyalty to our people.
^Cacildes: I know you... you’re the thief who stole those books the other night.
^Balbino: We meet again. Sadly, you ignored my warning... and now you’ve come seeking trouble.
^Balbino: I must prove myself—to my orc brothers, to Drogo... I *am* one of them. Molok will be free, and it begins with my hand.
^Balbino: Come. I’ll grant you an honorable end.
